title: Fix comment list creation stuck in loading state

requirements.summary: Fix the frontend async handling in useAdminComments.ts and AdminCommentsTab.tsx to properly await the backend response when creating a new comment list
acceptanceCriteria: The loading state ('Creating List...') resolves after backend responds
Success or error feedback is displayed to the user
The input field is cleared after successful creation

file_operations.description: Fix the createCommentList mutation to properly await the backend createCommentList method response and handle the Promise resolution correctly. Ensure the mutation's onSuccess callback triggers query invalidation for ['availableCommentLists'] to refresh the dropdown. Add proper error handling in onError to capture and surface backend errors to the UI.

Update the handleCreateList function to properly await the createCommentList mutation and handle the async response. Clear the newListName input field in the onSuccess callback after successful creation. Add toast notifications or inline error messages to display success/failure feedback to the user. Ensure the loading state (isCreating) is properly bound to the mutation's isPending state.

requirements.summary: Update the 'Manage Existing Lists' dropdown to automatically refresh and display newly created comment lists after successful creation
acceptanceCriteria: Newly created lists immediately appear in the 'Select List' dropdown
The dropdown updates from 'No lists available - create one above' to show the new list
The dropdown correctly populates with the list name that was just created (e.g., 'Story tv')

file_operations.description: Ensure the createCommentList mutation's onSuccess callback calls queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['availableCommentLists'] }) to trigger an immediate refetch of the comment lists. Verify that the useGetAvailableCommentLists query has proper cache invalidation and refetch settings to respond to the invalidation.

Verify that the Select List dropdown component is bound to the availableCommentLists data from useGetAvailableCommentLists. Ensure the dropdown re-renders automatically when the query data updates after cache invalidation. The dropdown should transition from showing 'No lists available - create one above' to displaying the newly created list name immediately after successful creation.

requirements.summary: Add proper error handling and user feedback for comment list creation failures
acceptanceCriteria: Display clear error messages if list creation fails
The loading state exits properly even on error
User can retry creation after an error

file_operations.description: Add comprehensive error handling in the createCommentList mutation's onError callback. Extract error messages from backend Runtime.trap responses and format them for user display. Ensure the mutation properly resets the loading state on error and allows retry attempts.

Add user-visible error feedback UI elements (toast notifications or inline error messages) that display when list creation fails. Show the specific error message returned from the backend. Ensure the button exits the 'Creating List...' loading state and returns to 'Create List' even on error, allowing the user to retry. Add validation to prevent empty list names before submission.
